action.description: rename: set title, or omit title to retitle from the first message. configure: model and effort. fork: copy the conversation into a new thread. handoff: move it to a new Git worktree on branch. interrupt: stop its current turn and its children. settle: archive it once done. snooze: mute its notifications until a time. close_preview: stop a preview server. rename_project: rename this project.

onlyIfProvisional.description: rename: only replace a title ace generated, never one the person chose.

requestId.description: Any stable id you choose (letters, digits, _ . -). Repeating a call with the same id does nothing twice.

runId.description: fork: fork after this run; default the latest.

threadId.description: A thread you own. Default: this thread.

until.description: snooze: epoch milliseconds, or null to unmute.

x-ace-constraint: configure needs requestId and model; fork and interrupt need requestId; handoff needs requestId and branch; snooze needs until; close_preview needs previewId; rename_project needs name.
